Oracle.Method: Unmodified installed JAR; public MapCodec parsed through RegistryOps/HolderLookup; getNoiseBiome queried with constant raw density fields; ordered biome identifiers hashed with one LF per name.
Oracle.Runtime: External Java helper and installed game/mod dependencies; empty FML loading catalogue initialized through LoadingModList.of; Minecraft Bootstrap.bootStrap; no Mixin transformation or full mod lifecycle. Registry lookup creates symbolic biome holders on request.
Oracle.Scope: Codec holder ordering and biome-selection bytecode only. Does not validate actual noise fields, dimension routing, pack order, mixins, terrain height, structures or full in-game parity.
